summary:
Creative and detail-oriented UI/UX/Graphic Designer with 10 years of
experience designing engaging and user-centered digital and print
experiences. Proficient in leading design projects from concept to completion,
with a strong emphasis on user experience, visual design, and brand
consistency. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver
innovative solutions that drive user satisfaction and business growth.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Illustrator→Adobe Illustrator(100%), Photoshop→Adobe Photoshop(100%), Indesign→Adobe InDesign(100%), Graphic→Graphic Design(93%), visual design→Graphic Design(100%)...)

bullets: Designed and prototyped user interfaces for Multiple Ministries such as Ministry of Textile, National Narcotics Control Buauro, Nation! Commision of Woman, Ministry of Agriculture-ICAR, NRML, Minstry of Ayush etc.
Created visual assets and graphics for web and mobile applications, adhering to brand guidelines and design principles.
Engaged in user research, including surveys and interviews, to gather insights and drive design decisions.
Collaborated with product managers and developers to create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, ensuring seamless handoff and implementation.
Developed and maintained design systems and style guides to ensure consistency across platforms and products.
Worked closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and resolve any design-related issues.
Designed marketing materials, including brochures, banners, and social media graphics, increasing brand visibility and engagement.
Collaborated with clients to understand their needs and deliver creative solutions that met their objectives.
Managed multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to client specifications.

Created visual content for marketing materials, social media, and websites and Collaborated with senior designers and other team members on various projects. Participated in brainstorming sessions and contributing ideas. Helped to maintain brand consistency across all designs.
